lines.trans: Kostya, it seems Vika loves me!
Great! Or is it?
Damn, Kostya, this is a dangerous situation.
If she loves me, a relationship is needed.
And what is bad about a relationship?
Then a wedding, and then kids!
Why do I need all of this right now?
You are simply afraid of adult life.
I love freedom and adventures!
Vika is a mature and smart girl.
She will not tolerate your nonsense.
Exactly, she will start educating me.
Then talk to her honestly.
No, better that I keep quiet.

examples.trans: We have nobody to fear here.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

взрослый.gloss: adult, grown-up; (as a noun) a grown-up

meanings.note: as a noun, often plural: взрослые = grown-ups

meanings.en: to bring up, to raise (a child)

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

держаться.gloss: to hold on; to stick with

meanings.note: за + accusative: держись за руку = hold on to my hand

meanings.en: to stick with, keep close to
meanings.note: + genitive: держитесь меня = stick with me

examples.text: Держитесь меня, и всё будет хорошо.
examples.trans: Stick with me and everything will be fine.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.

meanings.note: мне кажется = I think, it seems to me

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

молчать.gloss: to be silent, to say nothing

meanings.en: to be silent, to keep quiet
meanings.note: почему ты молчишь? = why aren't you saying anything?

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job

examples.trans: This is a very dangerous job.

examples.text: А я испорчу отношения с будущим мэром.
examples.trans: And I'll ruin my relationship with the future mayor.
We have a very warm relationship.

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)

meanings.note: comparative of далеко with prefix по-

examples.trans: Stand a little further back behind the pines.
Step a little further away from the fire.
The main adventure is only just beginning!

examples.text: В Москве Макса ждали новые приключения.
examples.trans: New adventures awaited Max in Moscow.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Watch the movie Wedding on Skype.
Right now there's freedom, cars, the sea!
He was released (came out to freedom).
This is a very complicated situation.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

терпеть.gloss: to bear, to put up with; to hold on

meanings.en: to put up with, to bear

meanings.note: e.g. to wait for the toilet

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.text: Ты же у нас такая умная!

examples.trans: Do you want me to tell you honestly?

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
